name: Science Technology
note: Science Technology Company (تقنية علم), a Saudi private defense and technology company headquartered in Al Diriyah, Riyadh (nationalcapital.com.sa partner page). Al Riyadh's club account announced it as official sponsor in September 2024. Ownership not yet sourced: the company's LinkedIn page lists founder and executive chairman Nasser Almadi, but no openable source names its owner(s). Stays unrated until an ownership claim is sourced.
